proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#7
proposed.text: Daredevil fights Muse again to save Heather Glenn, and Heather shoots Muse dead.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A serial killer Matt fights again to save Heather, who shoots him dead.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fights Muse again to save Heather Glenn, who then shoots Muse dead.

changes.evidence: Born Again S1#7 (Art for Art's Sake): Daredevil arrives at Glenn's office, rescues her and fights Muse; Glenn fatally shoots Muse. Muse's death is a stage. In S2 Muse appears only in Heather's flashbacks and hallucinations, so nothing new there.

now.title: Daredevil S2#9
now.text: Nobu returns alive, and Matt faces him again in the war with the Hand over Elektra.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A Hand leader who returns alive to fight Matt over Elektra.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Faces Nobu again in the Hand's war over Elektra.

proposed.text: Nobu returns alive from the fire, beats Matt in a second fight at the Hand's farm and escapes.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A Hand leader who returns alive and beats Matt in a second fight.

changes.evidence: In Daredevil S2#9 (Seven Minutes in Heaven) Nobu, back from the dead, beats Daredevil at the Farm and escapes with the sarcophagus. That the Hand wants Elektra (she is the Black Sky) comes out only in S2#12, so 'the war with the Hand over Elektra' gives away a later title.

proposed.title: Daredevil S2#13
proposed.text: Elektra dies stepping in front of the sai Nobu means for Matt, and Matt throws Nobu off the rooftop.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A Hand leader who kills Elektra while trying to stab Matt.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Throws Nobu off a rooftop after Nobu kills Elektra.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S2#13 (A Cold Day in Hell's Kitchen): Nobu tries to stab Daredevil with Elektra's sai, Elektra steps in front and dies; Daredevil ties a wire around Nobu and throws him off the roof (Stick then beheads him).

proposed.title: Daredevil S2#10
proposed.text: Reyes asks Matt and Foggy for help finding Castle and admits her part in the park massacre, then is shot dead in front of them.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The DA who turns to Matt for help, and is shot dead in front of him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A lawyer she turns to for help just before she is shot dead.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S2#10 (The Man in the Box): with Castle escaped, Reyes calls Nelson, Murdock and Page to her office, confesses her office ran the sting behind the massacre and pleads for help; she is gunned down in front of them as Matt pulls his friends down. Her death is a stage.

proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#3
proposed.text: Matt, as Daredevil, breaks into Red Hook and frees Soledad along with the other prisoners Fisk holds there.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Hector's widow, whom Matt frees from Fisk's prison at Red Hook.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Her husband's lawyer, who as Daredevil frees her from Red Hook.

changes.evidence: Born Again S2#2 Soledad is arrested by the AVTF; S2#3 (The Scales & the Sword): Daredevil infiltrates the Red Hook base and liberates the detainees, 'including Duquesne and Soledad Ayala', getting her and the others out of the cells.

proposed.title: Daredevil S2#8
proposed.text: Stick saves Matt and Elektra from the Hand and reveals that Elektra has worked for him since before she met Matt, when he sent her to recruit Matt.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Matt's old mentor, who saves him from the Hand and reveals Elektra worked for him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: His old student, whom Stick once sent Elektra to recruit.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S2#8 (Guilty as Sin): Stick rescues Matt and Elektra from Hand ninjas and, at Matt's apartment, reveals Elektra works for him and first met Matt on a mission to recruit him for Stick. A clear betrayal of Matt's trust.

proposed.title: The Defenders#6
proposed.text: Stick fights the Hand beside Matt and the Defenders, until Elektra kills him as Matt begs her to stop.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Matt's mentor, killed by Elektra as Matt begs her to stop.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: His student, who fights the Hand beside him until Elektra kills Stick.

changes.evidence: The Defenders#4-6: Stick finds the group and fights the Hand with them; in #6 (Ashes, Ashes) Elektra stabs Stick to death while Matt pleads with her not to. A death is a stage.

now.title: Daredevil S3
now.text: Theo Nelson is Foggy's brother and an old friend of Matt's from Hell's Kitchen.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Foggy's brother and an old friend from Hell's Kitchen.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An old friend of Theo's, and his brother Foggy's best friend.

proposed.title: Daredevil S3#13
proposed.text: Theo Nelson is Foggy's younger brother, and Matt joins the Nelson family dinner at Theo's butcher shop.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Foggy's younger brother, who runs the family butcher shop.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: His brother Foggy's best friend, at the family dinner.

changes.evidence: Theo appears in Daredevil S3#2, 5, 9, 11 and 13, always with Foggy. The only scene with Matt is the S3#13 (A New Napkin) family dinner at Nelson's Meats, where Matt is welcomed. Nothing on screen makes Theo 'an old friend of Matt's from Hell's Kitchen'.

proposed.title: Daredevil S2#13
proposed.text: Daredevil saves Turk and the Hand's other hostages just as the Hand starts sawing off Turk's foot.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A small-time crook Matt saves from the Hand.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Saves Turk from the Hand as it starts cutting off his foot.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S2#13: the Hand kidnaps people Daredevil has saved or put away, Turk among them, and starts cutting off his foot to remove his ankle monitor; Daredevil arrives and frees him. (In S2#1 Daredevil breaks Turk's hand again, the same pattern as the S1#11 stage.)

proposed.title: Daredevil S1#9
proposed.text: Matt visits Vanessa's gallery posing as a buyer, and she shows him around and introduces him to Fisk.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An art dealer who shows Matt her gallery and introduces him to Fisk.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A blind lawyer who visits her gallery and meets Fisk there.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S1#9 (Speak of the Devil): Matt goes to the Scene Contempo Gallery, Vanessa guides him through the art and introduces him to Fisk. Their first meeting, years before Born Again. Kind: Matt goes there to size up Fisk's weak point, so enemy, though she does not know it yet.

proposed.title: Daredevil S3#13
proposed.text: When Dex attacks the Fisks' wedding, Daredevil saves Vanessa from him, then makes Fisk go back to prison by threatening to expose her part in Nadeem's murder.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Fisk's new wife, whom Matt saves from Dex, then uses to force Fisk back to prison.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The masked man who saves her from Dex, then threatens her to force Fisk back to prison.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S3#13 (A New Napkin): Daredevil blocks Dex's attacks on Vanessa twice at the wedding; after beating Fisk he makes him return to prison or he will go after Vanessa, who ordered Nadeem's death, and unmasks in front of them both.

proposed.title: Daredevil S1#5
proposed.text: Vladimir blames the masked man for his brother's murder and tries to shoot him, but Matt beats him down.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A Russian gangster who blames Matt for his brother's death.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The masked man Vladimir blames for his brother's death, who beats him.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S1#5 (World on Fire): Vladimir finds the mask in Anatoly's jacket and blames the masked man; after the bombing the masked man ambushes him, Vladimir fires and misses, and is beaten until the crooked police arrive. They were enemies before the S1#6 alliance.

proposed.title: Daredevil S3#7
proposed.text: Fisk forces Melvin, with threats against Betsy, to copy the Daredevil suit for his impostor and to help frame Matt.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Forces Melvin, through threats against Betsy, to copy the Daredevil suit.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A craftsman Fisk forces to copy the Daredevil suit for his impostor.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S3#7 (Aftermath): Melvin had burned his workshop rather than help Fisk, but Fisk had a new one built and threatened Betsy; Melvin made the suit Dex wore to attack the Bulletin and a second one to frame Daredevil, then tried to trap Matt for the FBI on Fisk's orders.

now.title: Daredevil S1#9
now.text: Nobu pushes Fisk to clear the tenants from a building his people want. Fisk lures Daredevil into a fight with Nobu that ends with Nobu burning.
now.on_a_card_about_b: An ally who lures Daredevil into the fight that leaves Nobu burning.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The Yakuza's man in Fisk's alliance, pushing him to clear a building.

proposed.text: Nobu pushes Fisk to clear the tenants from a building his people want. Fisk sets him up to fight Daredevil, hoping both will die, and lets Nobu burn.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A partner who sets Nobu up to die fighting Daredevil.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The Yakuza's man in Fisk's alliance, whom Fisk sets up to die.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S1#9: Fisk goads Nobu into fighting the masked man himself; Fisk later admits that 'in a perfect world' the two would kill each other, and when he finds Nobu burning he tells Wesley to let him burn. This is a betrayal, not an alliance.

now.title: Jessica Jones S2#4
now.text: Oscar, who served time for forgery, fights to keep Vido when Vido's mother Sonia tries to take him away. Vido's admiration for Jessica, who saves his life, draws Oscar close to her.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Oscar's son, whom he raises and fights to keep.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Vido's father, who raises him and fights to keep him.

proposed.title: Jessica Jones S2#9
proposed.text: Oscar, who served time for forgery, is fighting for custody of Vido, and when Vido's mother Sonia runs off with him, Oscar gets him back at the bus station.

changes.evidence: Sonia taking Vido happens in Jessica Jones S2#9 (AKA Shark in the Bathtub, Monster in the Bed): Oscar finds Vido gone, tracks Sonia to the bus station and takes him back. In S2#4 Sonia only argues with Oscar and Jessica saves Vido at the window; the Jessica part of the text is about a third person.

proposed.title: Luke Cage S2#10
proposed.text: Ridley returns to lead the precinct and, impressed by Misty, offers her command of it once Ridley goes back to headquarters.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Misty's commanding officer, who offers her command of the precinct.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A detective Ridley offers command of the precinct.

changes.evidence: Luke Cage S2#9 Ridley, now deputy chief, takes over the precinct after Ridenhour's death; S2#10 (The Main Ingredient) after Misty exposes Nandi Tyler, Ridley tells her 'this precinct will need a new commander. I think it should be you.'

owner_calls.question: In Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7 Coulson is back as a Chronicom LMD. If this connection's Coulson includes the LMD, add a stage for May and him in S7?
options: Add stage, S7#2: 'May wakes to find Coulson back as a Chronicom LMD and tells him he is not Coulson, though they fight side by side again by the end.' (friend)
No stage: the LMD is a different person, or nothing turns
owner_calls.evidence: S7#2 (Know Your Onions): May, freshly healed, meets the LMD Coulson and tells him 'You're not Coulson... You still are [dead]'. Later they fight the Chronicoms together (S7#13) and she invites him to visit the Coulson Academy. Sarge in S6 has his own file (st-sarge), so S6 needs nothing.

owner_calls.question: Is this a real connection? The only on-screen tie is Powell ordering the AVTF to fire on the prisoners Daredevil frees from Red Hook, Jack among them.
owner_calls.evidence: Born Again S2#3: Daredevil frees Duquesne, Soledad and the other detainees; as they get outside Powell orders the AVTF to open fire on them. In S1#8-9 the AVTF arrests Jack, but no source shows Powell himself dealing with him.
